title: What's New: Project and Service Management (2024 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Directed put-away and pick for projects demo
Service order archiving and report selection
Service contract filing and retention policies

features.name: Directed put-away and pick for project locations
features.description: Support for locations with directed put-away and pick enabled for project consumption, allowing warehouse capabilities to work with projects using warehouse pick lines as mandatory.
caveats: Warehouse receipt scenarios are not supported for projects yet
One limitation still pending regarding directed pick and put-away

features.name: Extended text for project items
features.description: Added capability to insert extended text for project items, developed via code development contribution, with ability to configure automatic insertion for projects or invoices and print on project quotes.

features.name: Project replenishment from project planning lines
features.description: New action to perform replenishment directly from project planning lines, analyzing availability and suggesting purchases needed, with options to reserve items and create purchase orders.
caveats: Warehouse receipt scenarios for projects are not supported
If using white location with directed pick and put-away, cannot post purchase via warehouse receipt for immediate consumption

features.name: Item availability in project planning lines and journals
features.description: Added item availability information display in project planning lines and project journals, showing availability by event with related purchases and quantities.

features.name: Service quote and order archiving
features.description: Added archiving capability for service quotes and orders, allowing users to archive documents and access archived versions with restore functionality.

features.name: Make order action with dialog jump
features.description: Enhanced make order action when converting service quote to order, allowing users to jump directly to the newly created order via confirmation dialog, similar to purchase and sales areas.

features.name: Report selection for service item worksheet
features.description: Added support for report selection in service item worksheet, allowing users to change which report is printed, select different layouts, or print multiple documents at once.

features.name: Service contract filing improvements
features.description: Enhanced filing functionality for service contracts and contract quotes, now preserving filed versions even when main documents are deleted, with new toggle setting to control deletion behavior.
caveats: Filed contracts previously had a tendency to be deleted together with the main document

features.name: Retention policies for filed service contracts
features.description: Added retention policy capability for filed service contracts and service header archives, allowing control over database size management and deletion of archived documents.

features.name: Project cockpit action on project list
features.description: Added project cockpit action accessible from the project list, providing work in progress functionality allowing users to delete WIP entries and change the WIP method.

features.name: Project assembly orders access from list
features.description: Ability to navigate to assembly orders directly from the project list, building on the assembly-to-order capability added in a previous release.
